card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Not Charging After Screen Repair. Stuck at 0% Battery Level

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Not Charging After Screen Repair. Stuck at 0% Battery Level

claims.statement: iPhone 8 / 8 Plus stuck at 0–1% and not charging after a screen repair usually has pry damage to battery data MOSFETs Q3200 (I2C0_SMC_BI_GG_SDA_CONN) or Q3201 (I2C0_SMC_TO_GG_SCL_CONN); part number RV3C002UNT2CL.
The two small battery connector data pins should read about 0.665 in diode mode; OL means a damaged MOSFET or ripped pad needing a jumper.
Other causes: pushed-in battery connector centre pins, then Tigris (on iPhone 8 and later Tigris, not Tristar, causes these charge faults), then Hydra or lines under them.

procedure: Test known-good screen, port, battery and OEM charger.
Inspect battery connector pins; replace connector if smashed.
Diode-check the two small data pins (~0.665).
Replace Q3200/Q3201 or jumper ripped pads.
Then try Tigris, then Hydra; verify with stopwatch past 3 min and USB charge current.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
